description: Answers "Is this contractor licensed?", "Is their insurance current?" or "Vet these subcontractors". Looks up 1-10 Washington (Labor & Industries) or Oregon (Construction Contractors Board) contractors by license number (exact) or registered business name (exact, ignoring case, punctuation and LLC/Inc; never guesses between businesses sharing a name). Returns `ok` (active license, nothing lapsed), flags (license_expired, insurance_expired, ..._within_30_days, license_inactive, no_insurance_on_file) and the license record. Sole proprietors are shown by license number only. You are only charged when a result is returned: invalid input (400) and upstream failures (4xx/5xx) are not settled. Costs $0.01 USDC per call (up to 10 contractors) via x402. Paid per call with x402 inside MCP (see the server instructions).

business_name.description: The registered business name, e.g. Summit Roofing LLC. Used when no license number is given.

license_number.description: The contractor's state license number, e.g. SUMMIRL812AB (WA) or 123456 (OR).

state.description: WA (Labor & Industries) or OR (Construction Contractors Board).

via.description: Optional: the tool whose next_calls suggested this call (filled in for you).
